survey.notes: 69 of 2637 known pages surveyed; saturation reached (last new feature on page 18). Site-wide (>=80%): icons 96%, sticky header 94%, illustrations 94%, dialog 93% (mostly the cookie banner, plus search), card grids 91%, transitions 91%, logo walls 87%, CSS animation 86%, scroll reveals 86%, current-page marker 81%. Common: badges 68%, Lottie 59%, breadcrumb/sub-nav 55%, disclosures 54%, inputs 48%. Occasional: carousel 32%, forms 30%, quotes 29%, video 28%, banded sections 26%, tabs 25%, large images 22%. One-offs: loop 7%, theme toggle 7%, code block 6%, svg motion 6%, canvas 4%, choice 4%, table 3%, marquee 3%, rotate 1%, draw-on 1%. 16 pages captured in depth to cover every feature.

character.summary: A warm, unhurried editorial system: near-black ink on cream paper, text-serif headlines in sentence case, a quiet sans for everything else, and almost no color. Its voice comes from hand-drawn brush-ink pictograms — hands, sprouts, tools, globes — that open almost every section and play once, frame by frame at 12 fps, as if being sketched in front of you. Product UI is never shown bare; it sits on soft pastel stages with faint wandering lines, and everything settles into place with long, soft-landing 750–1000 ms easing.

motion.reducedMotion: Reference: a global rule sets every transition and animation to 0.01ms with iteration count 1, hides the page-transition overlay and disables dialog animations (motion.json reducedMotionRules). Template: same global kill switch; cel pictograms render their final frame statically; heading words and blocks appear at full opacity with no offset; carets stay visible (no blink); status glyph shows one static pose.
motion.notes: Two motion vocabularies coexist: (1) soft-landing tweened UI motion — long 750–1000ms power2-out reveals with small 10–20px offsets and word-staggered headings; (2) hand-made, stepped motion — 12 fps cel drawings, steps() sprite glyphs and steps(1) carets. Nothing bounces, nothing overshoots, nothing loops in the page chrome; loops live only inside demos and status indicators.

theming.notes: No toggle was found on the captured pages (theme.json toggles []); dark follows prefers-color-scheme (3–23 rules per page). Inside a page, sections switch palettes through .theme-main / .theme-accent / .theme-neutral / .theme-dark classes and [data-theme] attributes, each redefining the same 53 variables — so the footer and closing CTA are always ink, and a section can be 'dark' in light mode. Dark appearance: ground #141413, raised #1f1e1d/#262624, borders #30302e/#3d3d3a, text #faf9f5, muted #b0aea5; primary button inverts to paper with ink text; pictogram ink lines become paper, sand fills darken to warm gray, clay fills stay clay. The survey's ui:theme-toggle (5 pages) refers to toggles inside product demos/docs, not a site-level switch.

imagery.iconography: UI icons are small 16/20px (327 at 20px, 261 at 16px of 782 icons) thin-line glyphs rendered as fills, single color (currentColor, #141413 / #5e5d59), round-ish terminals; checklists use 16px filled ink check-circles. Third-party app icons appear at 24–32px on soft 8px-radius tiles.
imagery.illustration: Hand-drawn brush-ink pictograms: lines are filled outlines (not strokes) with uneven, marker-like weight and slightly wobbly geometry; one flat fill per piece — sand #e3dacc/stone #dedcd1, or clay #d97757 in heros; no gradients, no shading, no outline-less shapes. Subjects are everyday objects and hands (sprout, toolbox, magnifier with nodes, question mark in a circle, gauge, globe, book, shield, calendar, lightning, building, puzzle tiles) — a hand reaching, holding or placing something recurs in about a third. Composition: single centered object on empty paper, 1200x1200 artboard, ~60% of the box. Animated as Lottie with one precomp per frame at 12 fps (cel-style), playing once on view.
imagery.photography: Photos are rare and secondary: candid, natural-light, warm-toned people at work, cropped to small 16px-radius rectangles (hero mosaics, testimonials). Product UI screenshots and autoplay muted looping videos sit on pastel stages. Large images 22% of pages.

signatures.name: Cel-drawn ink pictograms
signatures.what: Hand-drawn object-and-hand pictograms in brush-weight ink (#141413) with one flat fill (sand #e3dacc, or clay #d97757 at hero scale), built as filled outlines whose edges wobble, redrawn frame by frame at 12 fps so the drawing appears to be sketched into existence, then holds. Sizes: 96px section openers, 64px in cards, 416–432px in heros.
signatures.frequency: svg:illustration on 94% of surveyed pages; Lottie on 59%; 4–12 per content page (p3: 11 Lotties, p6: 11, p15: 8). Every captured Lottie except one is 12 fps, 100% frame-by-frame, lines as filled outlines, no trim paths, two fills only.
signatures.recipe: Artboard 1200x1200 (render 64/96/416px). Draw each subject as 1) an ink layer: closed filled paths that trace a marker line 28–40 units wide on the 1200 board (~2.5px at 96px), with uneven thickness (±25%), rounded blunt ends and slight overshoot where lines meet; 2) a fill layer under it: one flat shape in --pictogram-fill (sand) or, for at most one hero piece per page, --accent (clay), offset a few units from the ink so it reads as hand-colored. No strokes, no gradients, no shadows, no third color. Subjects: an everyday object + optionally a simple hand (4–5 noodle fingers, no nails, no wrist detail) holding, placing or pointing at it. Animate as 12–48 separate drawings (one SVG <g> per frame, display toggled), each redrawn by hand so contours shimmer; build-up order: ground line or first contour, then the object, then the fill, then a final settle of 2–4 near-identical 'boil' frames. Implementation: an SVG with N frame groups and a CSS animation `steps(N, jump-none)` over N×83ms toggling visibility (or a Lottie with one precomp layer per frame), started by IntersectionObserver at 30% visibility, played once, ending on the last frame. In dark mode swap ink -> paper (#faf9f5), sand -> #5e5d59, clay unchanged. Make new subjects for each product; never trace reference artwork.
signatures.motion: Trigger: enters viewport (once). Keyframes: blank -> sketched build-up -> final pose hold, as discrete drawings, no tweening. 12 fps (83ms per frame), 1.3–4s for 96px openers, up to ~10s for hero pieces; iterations 1. Reduced motion: render the final frame only.

signatures.name: Pastel stage with wandering lines
signatures.what: Product UI, screenshots or live demos are always mounted on a large rounded panel (24–32px radius) in a muted pastel — cactus #bcd1ca, heather #cbcadb, peach #ebc9b7, sky #6a9bcc or clay — overlaid with faint tone-on-tone hand-drawn meandering lines (about 10–15% lighter than the panel, ~6–10px wide). Panels sometimes stack as 2–3 offset trays in different pastels. The UI on top is white with a soft 0 4px 24px 5% shadow.
signatures.frequency: Product, extension and resource pages (p2, p3, p8, p9, p10, p14) — every place a product surface is shown; 'IllustratedBackground' / 'MediaStage' components in motion.json visual targets.
signatures.recipe: Container: border-radius 24px (32px at hero size), background one of --stage-cactus/--stage-heather/--stage-peach/--stage-sky, overflow hidden, padding 48–64px around the content. Lines: an absolutely positioned SVG (viewBox matching the panel, preserveAspectRatio='none' avoided — use 'xMidYMid slice') with 3–6 open paths drawn freehand with smooth Béziers that wander off the edges; stroke = color-mix(in srgb, var(--stage) 70%, white), stroke-width 6–10px, stroke-linecap round, fill none, opacity 0.6. Content: white card(s) 8–16px radius with --shadow-raised; optionally 1–2 tray layers peeking 12–24px above in a second pastel at 90% width. Pick one pastel per stage and rotate pastels down the page; never two equal pastels adjacent.
signatures.motion: Stage rises with the block reveal (opacity 0 -> 1, translateY 20px -> 0, 750ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1)); trays slide in sequence when demo steps change (StepPanel, ~600ms). The lines themselves are static. Reduced motion: no offset, instant.

signatures.limits: Max one stage per viewport on dense screens, two on marketing pages; never behind body text or form fields; never as a page background; no gradients; lines never cross the content card visually (place the card above them). Clay stage at most once per page.

signatures.name: Serif headline that writes itself in
signatures.what: Every heading is a calm text serif (400–500 weight, 1.1–1.2 line-height, sentence case, no trailing period) on paper; on scroll the heading appears word by word — each word fades opacity 0 -> 1 over 1000ms with power2-out easing and a ~30–40ms stagger — while the lede and blocks below rise 10–20px over 750ms.
signatures.frequency: motion:reveal on 86% of pages; 'AnimatedHeading' word spans on every captured page with sections (reveal delays 0.029s, 0.057s, 0.086s … in motion.json); serif h1/h2 on every page.
signatures.recipe: Font: serif display (Source Serif 4, opsz high) at --display 72 / --h1 64 / --h2 52 / --h3 36 / --h5 25 / --h6 19px; weight 400 for heros, 500 for section h2s; letter-spacing normal (the face is set tight by default), line-height 1.1 display / 1.2 section; max-width 30ch; text-wrap balance. Split heading text into <span class='w'> per word (keep spaces as text nodes, aria-label on the heading). On intersect, add .in: `.w{opacity:0;transition:opacity 1000ms cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1) calc(var(--i)*35ms)} .in .w{opacity:1}`. Lede below: `opacity 0; translateY(20px)` -> none over 750ms, delay = last word delay + 100ms. Underlined serif words (text-decoration 1px, offset 0.15em) may act as inline dropdowns inside a sentence heading.
signatures.motion: Trigger: scroll into view (once). Words: opacity 0 -> 1, 1000ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), delay i×~35ms. Blocks: opacity 0 -> 1 + translateY 20px -> 0, 750ms same curve, staggered 100ms. Reduced motion: everything visible immediately.

signatures.limits: Word fade only on h1/h2 and empty-state titles, max ~4 per viewport; never on body, labels, numbers or table content; never all caps; never bold (max 500).

signatures.name: Hand-timed status glyphs
signatures.what: Live or 'working' states are shown with small stepped, hand-made motion rather than spinners: a 12–16px clay glyph that cycles through drawn poses with steps(84) over 5040ms, a 1200ms breathing dot (opacity .3 -> 1 -> .3) on running rows, and a steps(1) blinking caret (1000–1100ms) in prompt fields.
signatures.frequency: motion:loop on 7% of pages, always inside product demos (app shell, prompt fields, marketplace hero caret). Few occurrences but they are the only loops on the site and define how 'thinking/working' looks.
signatures.recipe: Glyph: design an ORIGINAL 16px mark (not a star/asterisk burst) — e.g. an ink blot that sprouts 3–6 short strokes — as a vertical sprite of 24–84 hand-drawn poses in --accent; element `overflow:hidden; height:16px`, inner strip `animation: glyph 5040ms steps(84, jump-none) infinite` translating 0 -> -(100% - 1 frame). Dot: 6px circle --text-muted `animation: breathe 1200ms ease-in-out infinite` (opacity .3 -> 1 -> .3). Caret: 1px × 1.1em ink bar `animation: caret 1000ms steps(1) infinite` (opacity 1 for half, 0 for half). Pair the glyph with a 12–15px muted sans gerund label ('Sorting…') that rotates through calm verbs every few seconds.
signatures.motion: Loop (infinite) while the state lasts: glyph steps(84) 5040ms; dot 1200ms ease-in-out; caret 1000ms steps(1). Stops and snaps to a static check or final pose when done. Reduced motion: static glyph pose, solid dot, steady caret.

applicationMap.use: Inline 'working' label with the stepped glyph instead of a spinner.

signatures.limits: One stepped glyph visible per screen; dots only on genuinely running items; never decorative; never on marketing headings; respect reduced motion.

signatures.name: Ink-and-paper ring controls
signatures.what: Controls carry no color: ink #141413 primary buttons and paper buttons with a 1px warm ring (#d1cfc5) drawn as box-shadow; on hover the ring simply thickens to 2px (and muted text turns ink); focus everywhere is a 2px clay #c46849 outline with 2–4px offset — the one routine appearance of the accent.
signatures.frequency: Ink and paper button styles on 58–64 of 69 surveyed pages; clay focus ring on every focusable element captured (interactions.json focus).
signatures.recipe: Primary: background --ink, color --paper, radius 8px, padding 8px 16px, font 15–17px weight 500, `box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 var(--ink); transition: color 100ms ease-in-out, background-color 200ms, box-shadow 200ms ease-in-out`; :hover `box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ink)`. Secondary: background --paper, color --text-muted, `box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 var(--paper), 0 0 0 1px var(--ring)`; :hover color --ink and `0 0 0 1px var(--paper), 0 0 0 2px var(--ring)`. Tertiary: background --stone (#e8e6dc), color #4d4c48. Small paper chips: :active `transform: scale(.985)`. :focus-visible `outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 4px` (2px on links/inputs). Dark: primary inverts to paper/ink, hover opacity .9.
signatures.motion: Hover 100–200ms ease-in-out (ring), nav text 500ms expo-out; press scale .985 in 100ms. Reduced motion: instant.

writing.casing: Sentence case everywhere — headings, buttons, nav, labels; no all-caps except 10px table column heads; headings have no trailing period.

writing.notes: Headings are 3–7 words, often a plain claim or an invitation; ledes one or two sentences in 20–23px muted sans; feature trios use '01/02/03' labels; quotes with a hanging open quote; numbers set in sans.

doNot: Do not use pure white as the page ground or pure black for text; the warmth of #faf9f5 and #141413 is the identity.
Do not add a brand color to buttons, links or headers; clay is a whisper (focus ring, one send square, one hero fill).
Do not draw pictograms with uniform vector strokes, gradients, isometric 3D or multiple colors; they are brush-ink outlines with one flat fill.
Do not tween pictograms smoothly; they redraw at 12 fps.
Do not set headings in the sans, in bold, or in all caps.
Do not use bouncy, springy or fast (<150ms) entrance motion; reveals settle over 750–1000ms.
Do not use drop shadows for resting elevation; use 1px warm rings and banding.
Do not use spinners; use the stepped glyph, breathing dot or caret.
Do not put pastels on text, controls or small UI; pastels are stage grounds and initials avatars only.
Do not crowd: keep 96–128px between sections and one pictogram per section.
ipRisks: Brand names and product names: Claude, Anthropic, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, Fable, Claude Code — never in tokens, copy, class names or the template name.
